text: Caught up with Delroy over coffee. His birthday's June 3rd and he keeps going on about wanting a record player. The kids are at his mum's that weekend so he's free. Remind me to sort something by the 1st.

Long chat with Katarzyna (Kasia) last night. She flies to Warsaw May 14 at 6am, then gets the train to her gran's. Dreading the four hour layover in Frankfurt. I should text her the night before. Her sister wants her to bring back pierogi for the whole family, which is a lot to fit in hand luggage.

Anika and Ryan are off to Japan for three weeks, leaving 9/2. Ryan has never done a long-haul flight and he's properly nervous, keeps reading about turbulence. Anika just wants Kyoto recommendations and someone to water the plants. Said I'd pop round the evening before to get the spare key.
Irina called. Her brother Lukas turns 40 on the 12th, drinks at the Crown from half 7. Apparently he's got really into fly fishing. Need to get a card and something small.

Tunde's surprise party for Erin is off, she found out. They're doing a quiet dinner Saturday at 8 instead. Tunde says she's obsessed with her pottery class right now so vouchers would go down well. Chip in with him on those.

Spoke to Henrik, he's back from Iceland. Flight home was delayed nine hours but he says the northern lights made up for it. Eva didn't go in the end, stayed home with their dog Bjorn who'd just had his op.
Eva's mum has her hip operation on October 28 at 9am. Eva's driving her in and is pretty anxious about the whole thing. Don't forget to message her that evening.
Kieran and Stefan are coming to stay, probably the weekend of the 21st. I'm doing a roast on the Sunday. Stefan's gone vegetarian.
Laura's birthday is 7/9. Into bouldering and true crime podcasts at the moment. Hates anything scented, so no candles.
Picked up the passport renewal form. Post it tomorrow morning before 10, photo booth at the station first.

Chidi rang from Lagos, he's out there until August 30 for his cousin's wedding. The line kept cutting out. Must call him back Sunday afternoon his time. He sounded happy though, said the aunties have been feeding him nonstop and his cousin's fiance is a great guy.
Ryan and Kiara had their anniversary dinner on Friday and he proposed! Wedding probably next summer. Kiara's sister Yasmin is already planning the hen.
Yasmin's flight to Toronto got cancelled, now rebooked for Thursday at 11pm. She's knackered and stressed she'll miss her friend Zoe's graduation on the 18th.
Zoe passed her driving test! Third time lucky. Remind me to send her something.
Coffee with Erin. She's started at the hospital pharmacy, loves it but the commute is brutal. Her partner Hemi is on nights for the next month. They're thinking about moving closer in the spring.
Pooja's little boy turns 5 on March 2nd. Dinosaurs, everything is dinosaurs. Party's the Saturday after, 2 till 4 at the soft play.
Hemi wants the photos from Rarotonga, send them over tonight. He still owes me his auntie's address in Auckland so I can post her the scarf.
Chris is running the Lisbon half on 3/22, his first one ever. He's been struggling with his knee and isn't sure he'll finish. Text him good luck the day before.
Bumped into Mabel at the shop. Her cat Pickle went missing on Tuesday and turned up last night, very thin. She's taking him to the vet tomorrow at 4.
Dev is thinking about Vietnam over Christmas and asked if I'd come. Check annual leave.
Bethany and Ravi's housewarming is Saturday from 7. They finally got the flat in Leith. Ravi doesn't drink, so bring something fizzy for him as well as wine.

Gareth's dad passed away last week. Funeral is November 4 at 11am in Swansea and he has to sort most of it himself because his brother is stuck in Dubai. He's holding up but sounds exhausted. Chris and I are driving down together the night before. I should call him at the weekend.
Mohammed and his wife are expecting their second in May. He's already worrying about flying to see her family in Amman with a newborn.
Luca's back from Sicily, brought me a massive tin of olive oil. Says his nonna's 90th was the best party he's ever been to.
Ask Caitlin how her interview went, it was this morning at 10. Claire said she'd been up all night prepping.
Claire's off to Thailand tomorrow, flight's at 6:40am. Leaving her dog Biscuit with the neighbour.
Jakub's birthday is Nov 9. He mentioned wanting a decent rain jacket for his Tatras trip in the spring. He's a large.
Remind me to ask Delroy how his daughter's recital went on Sunday.
Phoned Katarzyna. The visit to Anika's is called off, Anika's got flu. Maybe the 30th instead.
Book dentist. Pick up dry cleaning Friday after work. Renew car insurance before 11/15.

Irina says Henrik is moving to Oslo for work in January. He's nervous about the new job but excited. She's organising a leaving do for him on Dec 12 at 7, so keep that free. Lukas reckons it's his chance to finally learn proper Norwegian, he's already doing Duolingo every morning.
Stefan and Chris celebrate ten years on the 5th, dinner in Bath. Stefan's getting Chris a watch and I've sworn not to say anything.
Tunde's sister Mabel gets her A level results on 8/14. Tunde says she's been a wreck about it. Text her that morning.
Henrik likes Nordic noir, cold-water swimming and anything with cardamom in it.
Quick call with Kieran. He's in Dubai for work until Thursday then flies on to Sydney, landing Saturday at 5am. Already sounded jet-lagged.
Must post Zoe's present by Wednesday morning. Her birthday's Friday the 17th and the post is useless.
Laura said her mum has been in and out of hospital and she's really struggling to juggle it with work. Don't push her about the trip. Maybe pop round next week with some food.

Dinner with Chidi, Pooja and Ravi. Pooja's doing her yoga teacher training, finishes in June. Ravi's got an allotment now and won't stop talking about squash. Chidi is still looking for a flat and his landlord wants him out by the end of next month.
Video call Auntie Irina on Sunday at 2. It's her 70th on July 4th and she wants everyone on the call together.
Ryan had his appendix out on Tuesday. Kiara says he's grumpy but fine. Should drop off some books.
Mohammed recommended a travel insurance company for the long-haul stuff, can't remember the name. Ask him.
Lunch with Gareth, mostly football chat. He's still at the council, still hates the open plan office.

Luca and Caitlin met at Spanish class and now they're going to Seville together in October! Luca is terrified of flying so Caitlin booked the train via Paris. Took her three evenings to work out the connections. They want to have everyone round for paella when they're back.
Ring the travel agent Friday at 3pm about the Lisbon flights. Has to be done before the 9/30 deadline.
Yasmin says Zoe's gone vegan, for the record. Also allergic to cashews.

Claire's son starts uni in Edinburgh on Sept 15. She's driving him up the weekend before and is more upset than he is. Her husband Stefan is staying behind with the twins, who are apparently thrilled to get the big bedroom.
Eva texted, can't do Thursday any more because her shift changed. Coffee moved to Saturday at 10.
Met Jakub's girlfriend Anika Morris at the barbecue. She's a vet, just back from six months in Chile. Jakub is clearly smitten.
Katarzyna's back from Poland and her gran is doing much better. Remind me to ask her for the photos and whether she still wants to do Krakow on 5/14 next year.

Dev's wedding in Jaipur is Dec 2nd to 4th. Flights are crazy. I'm flying out on the 29th, Ravi's coming on the 1st, and Dev's cousin Pooja is sorting the hotel block for everyone. Dev's mum wants us all in proper outfits for the sangeet, so a tailor trip is needed once I land.
Pick up the keys from Bethany tomorrow evening after 6. She's away from the 8th to the 22nd and I'm feeding her cat Smudge.
Chris says Gareth's been really quiet since the breakup. Worth a call this week, just to see how he is.
Mabel's birthday is the 23rd. She said ages ago she wants a proper sourdough starter kit.

Long call with Kiara this morning. Her dad's retiring on June 30 after 35 years at the bank, and they're throwing him a party the Saturday after at their place. Kiara wants to fly her uncle in from Manila as a surprise but the tickets are silly money. She's also just started a pottery course on Tuesday nights and seems a lot happier than she was in the spring. Remind me to send her dad a card the week before.
Dr Ito said the results will be back by 11/3. Call the surgery after 2pm that afternoon.
Packing for Canada: adapters, warm coat, Laura's book to give back. Taxi booked for 4:15am Monday.
Anika's dissertation is due May 20 at noon and she's barely sleeping. Henrik and I are taking her out for curry once it's in.
Uncle Henrik's knee replacement went well yesterday, home by Friday hopefully. Auntie says he's already bored out of his mind. Send him the crossword books.
Pooja and Dev fly back from Goa tonight, landing 7:25 tomorrow morning. I'm doing the airport run so leave by 6.

Long catch-up with Ryan and Zoe at the pub. Zoe has accepted a place on a midwifery course starting in January and is moving back to Leeds for it, which means selling the flat in a hurry. Ryan's band has a gig at the Brudenell on 12/6 at 8 and he wants a big crowd. He also mentioned his mum's 60th is coming up in the new year, she's into gardening and gin. I should get the gig tickets this week.
